projects.title: EducaCross
projects.description: A hybrid, gamified educational platform with over 2,000 games aligned with the BNCC and adapted to each student's needs. It offers dashboards for teachers, pedagogical support, and multiplatform usage.
projects.summaryChallenge: Teachers lacked a view of each student's progress across thousands of learners.
projects.summarySolution: Gamified platform with dashboards, learning paths, and 2,000+ BNCC-aligned games.
projects.summaryResult: Used in more than 1,700 schools, with stronger student and family engagement.
longDescription: While at nav9.tech, I got to work as a tech partner with a few companies. One of those was EducaCross 2.0, where I helped on several fronts.

It is a robust and modern EdTech platform focused on teaching Math, Portuguese, Logic, and literacy, especially for Early Childhood and Elementary Education. With over 2,000 digital games aligned with the BNCC (Brazilian National Common Core), it combines adaptive gamification, hybrid learning, and real-time reporting to engage children aged 3 to 12.

Educators and school managers have access to advanced dashboards that allow the creation of personalized learning paths, student progress monitoring, and data aligned with the BNCC. There is also pedagogical support and ongoing training for teachers, effectively connecting technology with educational practice.

The platform is compatible with classroom, lab, mobile, and offline environments, promoting digital inclusion in schools. Its hybrid architecture prioritizes security (LGPD), accessibility, and scalability, currently used in over 1,700 schools with thousands of active users.
features: Full management of learning paths via backoffice
Analytical reports for teachers and managers
Extra content such as videos and EdTech forum
challenges: Exclusive layout based on access type (school profile)

projects.title: PDL - Portal Iguatemi
projects.description: The Iguatemi Portal is a secure B2B platform allowing store owners to access contract info, submit documents, and engage in marketing opportunities within the Iguatemi network, all in compliance with LGPD.
projects.summaryChallenge: Store owners needed a secure way to handle contracts, documents, and daily operations.
projects.summarySolution: B2B portal with access by profile, in compliance with LGPD.
projects.summaryResult: Operations for 15 malls and more than 2,800 stores in a secure environment.
longDescription: While at nav9.tech, I spent more than 3 years helping build Iguatemi's products, mostly on the Store Owner Portal.

The portal is an exclusive area for store owners and their teams, focused on corporate communication, sales info, contract management, tax audits, invoice handling, benefits, news, promotions, and internal processes. Users access through a secure, encrypted interface with user/password authentication, in full compliance with LGPD, ensuring access to functions according to profile and contract.
challenges: Secure handling of tenant and contract data
SEO and performance across multiple sections
achievements: Scalable platform covering 15 malls and over 2800 stores
Improved validation of store and contract information

projects.title: PDL - Portal Iguatemi v2
projects.description: New version of the Iguatemi Portal, with a modernized frontend, more tax-audit and invoice information, and an admin back office for internal operations.
projects.summaryChallenge: The portal needed a current interface and more tax-audit and invoice information for store owners, plus an internal flow to validate what they send.
projects.summarySolution: A rebuilt frontend, more than 60% more information in the portal, and a back office for tickets, requests, tax books, and reports.
projects.summaryResult: Tax audits and invoices more available, with review, approval, and management reports in the back office.
longDescription: V2 of the Iguatemi Portal modernized the entire frontend with current technologies. Sign-in moved to a Microsoft account, and the work went further than the login screen: the portal now distributes more information, with more than a 60% increase in the availability of tax audits and invoices on the platform.

I also built an admin back office for the internal team. From there they validate and open tickets, approve requests, resend documents, review and audit the tax books sent by store owners, and follow management reports on invoices, users, requests, and audits.
features: Greater availability of tax audits and invoices for store owners
Back office to validate and open tickets
Review and audit of tax books sent by store owners
Management reports for invoices, users, requests, and audits
challenges: Modernizing the frontend without interrupting people already using the portal
Expanding tax-audit and invoice information while keeping security and LGPD compliance
Bringing validation, approval, resending, and audit into one back office
Delivering management reports without exposing store-owner data outside the authorized profile
achievements: More than a 60% increase in the distribution of tax-audit and invoice information
Review and audit of tax books sent by store owners
Management reports for invoices, users, requests, and audits

projects.title: ICEH Retriever
projects.description: Comprehensive data platform designed to provide open and easy access to standardized data on Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, and Child Health and Nutrition (RMNCH+N) indicators worldwide.
projects.summaryChallenge: Health indicators were scattered in formats that were hard to compare.
projects.summarySolution: Search, filters, and export of standardized indicators.
projects.summaryResult: Open access to comparable data for research and public policy.
longDescription: The ICEH Retriever is a comprehensive data platform developed to provide open and easy access to standardized data on Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, and Child Health and Nutrition (RMNCH+N) indicators worldwide. The platform covers over 100 indicators, more than 120 countries, and draws from more than 490 nationally representative surveys.

All indicators in the ICEH Retriever are harmonized and standardized, ensuring comparability over time and across countries. Data are available disaggregated by eight key inequality dimensions, enabling users to explore patterns and trends that highlight where progress is equitable, and where disparities persist.
The platform was developed to support academics, country teams, and international organizations in advancing evidence-based decision-making and accountability for RMNCH+N outcomes.
achievements: Support for research and policy analysis

projects.title: PortoCon Accounting
projects.description: Institutional website focused on local conversion for accounting client acquisition, with clear communication, humanized service, and a CTA-driven journey.
projects.summaryChallenge: Little digital presence for local searches.
projects.summarySolution: Service pages tuned for local SEO and direct WhatsApp contact.
projects.summaryResult: A clearer path to contact and a base ready to grow through search.
longDescription: PortoCon is an accounting firm based in Brusque with a positioning centered on personalized service, process clarity, and business security. The project was built as an institutional website to translate that positioning into an objective and trustworthy digital journey.

The content architecture was designed to reduce decision friction: value proposition at the top of the page, clear service differentiators, and guidance blocks for high-intent actions such as opening a company and switching accountants.
Special attention was also given to performance, responsiveness, and local SEO, with dedicated page structure to strengthen accounting-related regional searches and improve contact conversion.
features: Institutional website with dedicated pages (About, Open Company, Switch Accountant, and Office)
Conversion-oriented content structure with strategic CTAs
Metadata and sitemap configured for search indexing
Responsive layout with consistent mobile and desktop experience
WhatsApp contact integration for fast customer support
Visual organization focused on readability and trust
challenges: Balancing commercial language with technical accounting content
Structuring service pages without overloading navigation
Ensuring strong performance on section-rich pages
Consolidating local SEO for regional search intent
Maintaining visual identity consistency across all touchpoints
achievements: Strong and professional institutional digital presence
Clearer contact journey for new clients
Technical foundation prepared for organic growth
Accessible and responsive experience across devices
